meta.description: Index of golden fixtures and the legacy sources they were generated from.
meta.non_finite_encoding: NaN, Infinity and -Infinity are stored as the strings "NaN", "Infinity", "-Infinity"

known_issues.F1: Temperature detector misses injected spikes: global median/MAD is inflated by the sinusoidal baseline.
known_issues.F2: Capacity-step detector raises false positives (no capacity steps are injected); edge cycles affected by truncated centred window.
known_issues.F3: RUL '95% fit interval' uses slope standard error only, so it is far narrower than real forecast error.
known_issues.F4: Simulator baseline cycles-to-EOL differs from the Overview linear RUL for identical conditions.
known_issues.F5: Insight #2 always says 'Fade is accelerating' regardless of the computed slopes.
known_issues.F6: Linear model is structurally biased on quadratic-fade data.
known_issues.F7: Capacity-step detector uses a centred window, i.e. future cycles (not causal).
known_issues.F8: Advisor delta for a null/zero cycles-to-EOL is 0 in ui.js but null in core.js.
